recommendation: Keep the commit as-is. It fixes the only stale source wording found for FHIR-54651, and the duplicate issues should remain related background rather than separate reconcile commits.
issue_request: FHIR-54651 was Applied/Persuasive with Modification for R6 Pharmacy. It requested removal of DosageDetails.simple, documentation/example updates, removal of the old dosdet-1 invariant, and a replacement invariant prohibiting DosageDetails.step.safety when there is only one step; a Jira comment clarified the issue was about DosageDetails, not Dosage.
initial_application: Jira-tagged commits accc7b7f11, 741be42b1e, and fc2e165a09 had already marked !DosageDetails.simple in the datatype spreadsheet, updated dosage.html and dosage examples, and corrected the new no-safety-on-simple invariant context. The remaining stale item was the changelog entry introduced with the initial application, which said Dosage.simple.
additional_context: FHIR-54524 and FHIR-54337 are duplicate same-change ballot comments. Pharmacy minutes and a Medication Zulip thread refer to removing DosageDetails.simple. source/fhir.ini keeps datatypes and DosageDetails in the active datatype mapping, so the datatype changelog correction is in current build scope for this source family.
reconciliation: Changed source/datatypes/_changelog.txt to say DosageDetails.simple in both FHIR-54651 changelog sentences. No other source changes were needed because the datatype spreadsheet, narrative text, invariant, and examples already matched the applied decision.
source_changes: source/datatypes/_changelog.txt: changed the FHIR-54651 changelog entry from Dosage.simple to DosageDetails.simple.
